about: The mapping exceptions table: a Missions crew reference (C-n) to the Personnel v2 identifier (PRS-nnnn) of the same person, for every case the exact-name step cannot place. It records known discrepancies of name and is reused by every later mapping release. Every target MUST exist in the pinned Personnel v2 snapshot, and the table never names a v1 identifier (CRW-nnnn). The process (crew_mapping.py) reads it first, and a match stops the process.

reasons.C-71: Picard: the Missions recipe writes Picard, Personnel v2 writes Jean-Luc Picard (already in Personnel v2 as PRS-0001).
